name: near-standards
skills: Conformance review of NEAR smart contracts in Rust against the contract standards: NEP-141 fungible tokens (ft_transfer, ft_transfer_call, ft_on_transfer and refunds), NEP-145 storage management (storage_deposit, storage_withdraw, storage_unregister), NEP-148 metadata, NEP-297 events, NEP-171 non-fungible tokens, NEP-178 approvals. Reviews attached contract code against each requirement and quotes the lines each finding rests on. Knowledge: the NEAR Enhancement Proposals (CC0).
examples: Does this token contract follow NEP-141 and NEP-145, and what breaks for wallets and exchanges if not?
Review how this contract receives tokens with ft_on_transfer and returns what it does not use.
Is the storage deposit of this contract handled the way NEP-145 requires?
